sqlMap.select:
SELECT NOTICE_ID, TITLE, WRITER_ID, VIEW_CNT, TOP_YN, REG_DT FROM TB_NOTICE
TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #keyword#, '%')
TOP_YN = #topYn#
ORDER BY TOP_YN DESC, $sortCol$ LIMIT #startRow#, #pageSize#
SELECT NOTICE_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER_ID, VIEW_CNT, TOP_YN, REG_DT FROM TB_NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #value#
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO TB_NOTICE (TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER_ID, VIEW_CNT, TOP_YN, REG_DT) VALUES (#title#, #content#, #writerId#, 0, #topYn#, NOW())
sqlMap.update: UPDATE TB_NOTICE SET VIEW_CNT = VIEW_CNT + 1 WHERE NOTICE_ID = #value#
